svg.aria-label: Auto-rotating 3D carousel of 8 projects: NEX AI, NEX Ecosystem, JARVIS Agent House, NexPet, EDU-LINK Pakistan, FFW Central Block, PDF and Document Suite, AI Motion Film

g.text: An assistant built to think, plan and learn — powered by
free and open models, with a showcase site and live demo.
A WhatsApp bot and a private chat network, run from
one owner login with approvals and managed groups.
A JARVIS-style brain with an Agent House status
dashboard and an OSINT hub wired in.
A Windows desktop pet with 8 characters, a local AI
brain, offline reminders and a cute voice.
School landing pages with Super Admin and School Admin
portals — plus an offline AI assistant in each.
A browser 3D open-world game in a single HTML file,
with procedural characters tuned for low-end PCs.
Ten premium tools — merge, split, compress, convert,
A 7-minute cinematic film on how AI is changing the
world — Remotion and Three.js, 1080p at 30 FPS.
